items.title: Positive Breakout: These 7 stocks cross above their 200 DMAs
items.description: In the Nifty500 pack, seven stocks' closing prices crossed above their 200-day moving averages (DMA) on October 28, 2026, according to StockEdge's technical scan data. The 200-day moving average (DMA) is used by traders as a key indicator for determining the overall trend of a stock. As long as a stock's price remains above its 200-day moving average on the daily timeframe, it is generally interpreted as being in an overall uptrend.

items.title: Jio listing propels Reliance past Tata Group as India's biggest conglomerate
items.description: The listing of Jio Platforms has significantly impacted India's corporate rankings, with Reliance Industries regaining the top position. Reliance's market capitalisation rose to approximately ₹30.26 lakh crore, overtaking the Tata Group. Jio's shares closed at ₹1,417.35, reflecting a 26.66% premium over the issue price. This transition highlights the challenges faced by other conglomerates, such as the Tata Group and Mahindra Group.

items.title: Jio Platforms breaks into global top 5 telcos after listing
items.description: Jio Platforms made its public listing in India, achieving a market cap of $137.3 billion. This valuation positions it as the fifth-largest telecom company worldwide, surpassing Deutsche Telekom. Global competitors like China Mobile and Verizon continue to lead in market capitalization. Jio's valuation reflects its advanced 4G and 5G networks, which differ from legacy infrastructures of global giants.

items.title: Jio Platforms draws bullish bets, analysts see up to 28% upside
items.description: Four brokerages have begun coverage on Jio Platforms just before its upcoming listing with favorable ratings. Nomura, Motilal Oswal Securities, and Elara Capital issued 'Buy' ratings indicating significant upside potential. Dolat Capital provided an 'Accumulate' rating with a higher target price suggesting a 28% increase. Analysts believe Jio Platforms may influence tariffs in the telecom industry substantially.

items.title: MSCI puts Polycab exit on hold amid insolvency case uncertainty
items.description: MSCI has decided to delay the removal of Polycab India from its indices amid insolvency uncertainty. The company was placed on the Insolvency Resolution Process board on October 7. However, the National Company Law Appellate Tribunal stayed the company’s admission to the insolvency process on October 9. MSCI continues to monitor the status of Polycab India and any related orders from the NCLAT.

items.title: Jio Platforms shares surge 21% on debut, overtake Airtel in market cap
items.description: Jio Platforms made a remarkable entrance in the stock market, soaring 21.4% above its IPO price on the first day of trading. Closing at ₹1,417.35, the stock surpassed Bharti Airtel in market capitalization. With a staggering 22 times oversubscription, the IPO attracted considerable institutional backing. At the launch event, executive director Anant Ambani recognized the invaluable support from millions of subscribers.

items.title: Stocks in news: Jio Platforms, RIL, Hero MotoCorp, Meesho, TVS Motor, Vedanta Aluminium and Suzlon Energy
items.description: Indian equities ended lower on Wednesday, primarily driven by selling in heavyweight stocks. Information technology and oil and gas shares experienced significant declines, falling more than 2%. The Nifty 50 index settled at 22,699, down 51 points, indicating ongoing resistance at 22,800. Several companies, including Jio Platforms and Hero MotoCorp, reported their quarterly earnings that impacted market sentiment.

items.title: D-Street poised for positive start as GIFT Nifty signals gains
items.description: Benchmark Nifty experienced a marginal decline after recovering from a significant low during the trading session. Analysts believe Indian equities may remain range-bound. The rupee weakened against the US dollar due to rising crude oil prices and a strengthening dollar. Foreign portfolio investors were net buyers on Wednesday, with significant purchases noted.

items.title: Sensex, Nifty fall as IT stocks slide, rising oil prices weigh
items.description: Indian equity markets took a hit on Wednesday, primarily due to declines in the IT sector and escalating crude oil prices. Both the Sensex and Nifty closed lower, showcasing investors' cautious mood amidst significant intraday drops. Key downturns were influenced by Reliance Industries along with various IT stocks, but the auto sector and select banking stocks sparked some buying activities that alleviated part of the losses.

items.title: Sebi to review FPI rules, align with global norms
items.description: The Securities and Exchange Board of India is set to release a consultation paper aimed at refining compliance requirements for foreign portfolio investors. Chairman Tuhin Kanta Pandey highlighted the progress in the onboarding of international funds while pointing out the heavy compliance burden in India. Sebi is also considering the possibility of self-listing for stock exchanges despite the challenges that may arise.

items.title: Stock Radar: RIL showing signs of recovery; forms triple bottom formation on weekly charts – time to buy?
items.description: Reliance Industries Ltd has found support around the 1,100 level, indicating a possible bounce back. Medium-term traders are advised to consider buying the stock for targets above 1,300 levels. The stock recently closed at Rs 1,200, having experienced a decline over the past months. Analysts note a triple-bottom pattern that could signal easing selling pressure. Investors should assess technical indicators before making trading decisions.

items.title: Jio Platforms lists on NSE as 3,138th company, making Ambani family proud with a 21.36% surge
items.description: Jio Platforms became the 3,138th company to list on the NSE after a significant public offering. The listing resulted in a notable 21.36% increase, making Jio the second most valuable Indian company. Mukesh Ambani expressed strong emotions as he witnessed his children outline their vision for the future. Following the listing ceremony, the family visited a temple and celebrated with a drone show.
